summary: No GitHub repository was found for this paper. A thorough search of the full paper text (6 pages, read completely), prepass.json, arXiv HTML/PDF versions, author GitHub profiles (aferikoglou, GeoAnagn, akapetanakis, sxydis), GitHub code search by exact paper title, and web searches all failed to find any repository. The paper presents an FPGA accelerator for FEM-based CFD simulations implemented with HLS, but does not include a code availability statement or link to any public repository. The closest author repos (e.g., aferikoglou's GenHLSOptimizer, CollectiveHLS) are about general HLS optimization tools, unrelated to this specific CFD accelerator. This paper is not a survey/position paper (it presents a concrete design), so no_artifact is false — the code simply was not released/published on GitHub.
